name: whois-lookup
title: WHOIS Lookup
description: Look up WHOIS records for a domain using the who.is API
author: rmjh

commands.name: whois
commands.title: WHOIS
commands.subtitle: who.is
commands.description: Look up the WHOIS record for a domain. Enable as a fallback command to type "whois example.com" directly.

commands.name: dns
commands.title: DNS Records
commands.subtitle: who.is
commands.description: Look up a domain's current DNS records. Enable as a fallback command to type "dns example.com" directly.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: who.is API Key
preferences.description: Create one at https://who.is/account/api (starts with wis_live_)
